body:
Adds `research/twin-upkeep` (MIT, pure Python, 13 tests, whitepaper, reproducible experiments), a README bullet and a homepage entry in the Digital twins theme.

- Closed-form steady-state tracking variance of a Kalman twin for a drifting actuator gain, matched to closed-loop simulation (1-3%), plus the resulting control regret.
- A frozen twin loses half its edge over the population mean in ln 2/(2(1-rho)) steps.
- One drifting parameter: dedicated probing never pays (information price vs marginal value).
- Two parameters: closed-loop blind direction gives a mean-field dither law nu* ~ q^(1/6); simulation shows certainty-equivalent gain jitter supplies most of that excitation, so the law is an upper bound (reported as a limitation).

`python site/build.py` prints ok.
